answer_1.quote: We introduce the first audio-visual spoken dialogue model that can directly process audio-visual speech as user input and generate audio-visual speech as the output response.
answer_1.outputs: audio-visual speech tokens synthesized into talking face video

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the semantic quality and the generation quality of both audio and video. For the semantic quality, we first generate transcriptions... and employ standard metrics used for text-based dialogue generation: log-perplexity (PPL), BLEU, METEOR, F1, D-1, and D-2. To measure the generation quality of video, we adopt metrics... Fréchet Inception Distance (FID), LSE-C, LSE-D. To evaluate the acoustic quality, we compute speaker similarity (SIM)...
